Horizontal line of the head lamp bulb center
Turn the low beam on without driver aboard.
The cut-off line should be projected in the cut-off line shown in the picture.
When aiming the low beam, vertical aiming should be adjusted after adjusting the horizontal aiming.
Disengage the parking brake and put the gear in N (Neutral), in addition, if headlamp leveling device is equipped, adjust the headlamp leveling device switch to '0'.
